The three street-front units on the east side of General Luna Street between the lettered No. 2 bay and the corner (also way/23664825 and way/23671921), joined into one outline from their own vertices; their depth and the gaps between them are as mapped. Edit dates are not construction dates. Generated subdivision: Dinaga.

sources.title: Owner request: Socorro Abella Building
sources.note: October 9, 2026. Supplied by the owner as the Google Maps place Socorro Abella Building at 13.62230, 123.18440, on General Luna Street near New China Restaurant.

sources.title: Google Street View: Socorro Abella Building, General Luna Street
sources.note: August 2025 panorama inspected October 9, 2026. The two-storey facade is lettered SOCORRO ABELLA BUILDING with 1929 and No. 2 over its northern bay, and again with 1929 near the southern end above the corner pharmacy, with arched upper windows over ground-floor shops. The lettered 1929 is taken as an approximate construction year. Capture dates are not construction dates; no image is saved or distributed.

sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the structures of the rows of the Abella Business Building on General Luna Street for preservation; it does not name the Socorro Abella Building, which is not claimed as a listed member.

text.en: Its facade is lettered Socorro Abella Building, with the year 1929.
The two-storey row runs along General Luna Street to the corner, with arched upper windows over ground-floor shops.
The city listed General Luna Street's rows of Abella business buildings for preservation in 2003.
